clips.title: The story
paras: In Hillsbrad Fields, the town hall keeps a ledger of the settlement's surviving citizens and landowners. The Hillsbrad Town Registry records civic matters, and the Forsaken seek it during their offensive against the human stronghold.

The Hillsbrad Town Registry records the town's people and rights. It rests in the town hall near the podium of Magistrate Burnside. From Tarren Mill, the Forsaken press to break human resistance in the foothills. Darthalia sends Horde champions into the town hall to kill the council and seize the ledger. Its records cover Hillsbrad's population, households, and administrative rights. The registry would strip the town of its civic order and give the Undercity intelligence on the surviving population and their assets.
